## The idea

What should ReliKey do, or decide, that it does not yet?

## Why it fits

ReliKey is a distribution, not a new engine (decision 0001): it composes, it does not fork or patch components. Say how
the idea stays inside that line - a KeyClerk plugin, an upstream change, or a composition change - rather than new
engine code here.
